ValidationRule.description: If the portal type is SFS, answer if FW will provide Payor Support.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISPICKVAL(Portal_Type__c, "SFS -Student Financial Software"), ISBLANK(TEXT(FW_Providing_Payor_Support__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For SFS clients, you must select whether Flywire is providing support for this product or not.
